diff --git a/lizard_languages/javascript_templates.py b/lizard_languages/javascript_templates.py
index b97886c..e10a849 100644
--- a/lizard_languages/javascript_templates.py
+++ b/lizard_languages/javascript_templates.py
@@ -93,6 +93,44 @@ def _converted_template(source, start, end, token_class, split):
     yield token
 
 
+def interpolation_code(source, in_expression=False):
+    """Spans of the code in the interpolations of a template, at any depth.
+
+    The source is a whole template, or the expression of an interpolation.
+    Nested templates split the code around them, so that each character is
+    scanned once.
+    """
+    if not (in_expression or (source.startswith('`') and '${' in source)):
+        return
+    stack, pos, code = ([1], 0, 0) if in_expression else ([0], 1, None)
+    while stack:
+        pattern = _TEMPLATE_SPECIAL if stack[-1] == 0 else _EXPRESSION_SPECIAL
+        match = pattern.search(source, pos)
+        if match is None:
+            break
+        token = match.group()
+        pos = match.end()
+        if stack[-1] == 0:
+            if token == '${':
+                stack.append(1)
+                code = pos
+            elif token == '`':
+                stack.pop()
+                code = pos
+        elif token == '`':
+            yield code, match.start()
+            stack.append(0)
+        elif token == '{':
+            stack[-1] += 1
+        elif token == '}':
+            stack[-1] -= 1
+            if stack[-1] == 0:
+                yield code, match.start()
+                stack.pop()
+    if stack and stack[-1]:
+        yield code, len(source)
+
+
 def template_tokens(source, addition='', token_class=None, split=True):
     """Tokenize ordinary spans normally; TSX retains atomic template tokens."""
     pattern = compiled_token_pattern(addition)

+    def process_token(self, token):
+        # An interpolation is one token for the states, or a part of one in
+        # TSX; the conditions written in it are counted here.
+        previous = self._previous_token
+        self._previous_token = token
+        if previous == '${':
+            self._count_interpolation_conditions(token, True)
+        elif (type(self)._scan_atomic_templates
+                and token[:1] == '`' and '${' in token):
+            self._count_interpolation_conditions(token, False)
+        return False
 
     def __call__(self, tokens, reader):
         # Custom hooks and state configurations retain the generic protocol.
+        # TypeScriptReader.process_token only adds interpolation conditions and
+        # always returns False, so the fast path may keep calling it. Instance
+        # or subclass hooks still fall back to CodeReader.__call__.
         states = self.parallel_states

+                not in allowed_process):

             return
         self.context = reader.context
         state = states[0]
         # Binding candidates are children and retain their own wrapper.
         consume = CodeStateMachine.__call__.__get__(state)
+        after_interpolation = self._previous_token == '${'
+        scan_atomic = type(self)._scan_atomic_templates
         for token in tokens:
+            # Ordinary JS/TS tokens pay only after_interpolation / '${' checks.
+            if after_interpolation:
+                self._count_interpolation_conditions(token, True)
+                after_interpolation = False
+            elif token == '${':
+                after_interpolation = True
+            elif scan_atomic and token[:1] == '`' and '${' in token:
+                self._count_interpolation_conditions(token, False)
             consume(token)
             yield token
+        self._previous_token = '${' if after_interpolation else None
